I am working with SILVA arb output with EMBL taxonomy. Your regex assumes a tab delimits the header fields but in my data it is a space.

I'm interested in building taxid files in the form of taxdb.btd and taxdb.bti. Do you have a script that can convert your extract_taxonomy output to these standard formats?

Matt

Hi Matt,

So, I dont think I will be able to make a function to output a custom BLAST taxonomy database. I asked NCBI for the format of taxdb.btd and taxdb.bti and got the following response:

Hi,
Thanks for writing to us.
Lacking the proper context, it is difficult to know what is the use case for this since this set of files is used solely by standalone BLAST tools in conjunction with the preformatted databases provided by NCBI, with the purpose being to map a given set of sequence id to their scientific name through their taxis, encoded in the database entry (from preformatted blast databases provided by NCBI).
Since it is used for this quasi internal purpose, there is no specs nor standalone tools to write it in that format. Your understanding will be greatly appreciated.

One of the files is binary, so I cannot even guess at what the format is. Sorry about that.
